# Scalemate

> Scalemate is an ad operations platform for media buyers and user-acquisition teams running paid social at scale. It launches hundreds of Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok ads in minutes, automates campaign management with rules, and bulk-syncs creatives — cutting hours of daily manual ad ops.

Scalemate focuses on Meta and TikTok. Core capabilities: bulk ad launch, bulk creative upload from Google Drive, automation rules (auto-pause low-ROAS ads, scale winners, protect daily budget), and faster campaign scaling. Built for UA managers, media buyers, and founders.

## Product
- [Bulk Ad Launch](https://www.scalemate.co/use-cases/bulk-ad-launch): Launch hundreds of Meta & TikTok ad sets from one campaign template.
- [Automation Rules](https://www.scalemate.co/features/automation-rules): Rule engine to auto-pause low-ROAS ads, scale winners, and protect budgets across Meta & TikTok.
- [Bulk Launch](https://www.scalemate.co/features/bulk-launch): Deploy ads at scale from a single template with creatives synced from Google Drive.
- [Ad Creative Uploader](https://www.scalemate.co/ad-creative-uploader): Bulk upload and sync ad creatives from Google Drive to Meta & TikTok in seconds.
- [Scale Ad Campaigns Faster](https://www.scalemate.co/use-cases/scale-ad-campaigns-faster): Workflow for scaling winning campaigns without growing manual workload.
- [AI Assistant](https://www.scalemate.co/ai-assistant): AI helper for ad campaign management tasks.
- [For Media Buyers](https://www.scalemate.co/solutions/media-buyers): How media-buying teams use Scalemate to cut routine ad ops.
- [Pricing](https://www.scalemate.co/pricing): Plans and pricing.
